accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let k[x1, ..., xn] with n > 1, and let Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) be the subgroup of polynomial automorphisms whose Jacobian determinant is 1. Let T = {diag(t1, ..., tn) | product_{i=1}^n ti = 1} be the diagonal torus acting by xi -> ti xi. A nonzero locally nilpotent derivation D of k[x1, ..., xn] is called a root vector with respect to T if there exists a nontrivial character chi: T -> G_m such that sigma o D o sigma^{-1} = chi(sigma) D for every sigma in T. Which characters chi occur as roots of Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) with respect to T, and which locally nilpotent derivations D are the corresponding root vectors?
accepted.context_brief: Roots of the volume-preserving affine Cremona group

accepted.question_text: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0 and let Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) denote the subgroup of polynomial automorphisms of k[x1, ..., xn] with Jacobian determinant 1. A subgroup G of Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) is called ∂-generated if there exists a set Gcal of locally nilpotent derivations of k[x1, ..., xn] such that G is generated by the automorphisms exp(D) with D in Gcal; it is called finitely ∂-generated if there exists a finite set Gcal such that G is generated by all automorphisms exp(fD) with D in Gcal and f in Ker(D). Is the full group Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) ∂-generated? If it is, is it finitely ∂-generated?
accepted.context_brief: Generation by exponentials of locally nilpotent derivations
